legal_units.title: Search and seizure
legal_units.text: An income-tax authority having territorial jurisdiction over a place but not jurisdiction over the person may exercise powers under sub-section (1) where delay in obtaining authorisation from the authority having jurisdiction over that person may prejudice the interests of revenue.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 247 Search and seizure Section 247(2): An income-tax authority having territorial jurisdiction over a place but not jurisdiction over the person may exercise powers under sub-section (1) where delay in obtaining authorisation from the authority having jurisdiction over that person may prejudice the interests of revenue.

legal_units.text: Where specified books, documents, electronic information, computer systems or assets are suspected to be kept at a location not mentioned in the original authorisation, the specified income-tax authority may authorise the officer to exercise the powers under sub-section (1)(i) to (vii) at that location.
